audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags that the level chart gives Morgana all 7 stages while Pyke wins the aggregate 53.17% of games.
audit.why: The content whys[]/spikes text is well-grounded in real kit interactions (Black Shield negates Pyke's entire CC-reliant kit including his R execute; Dark Binding out-ranges his engage), which is a genuine, verifiable reason Morgana could win every laning stage even if Pyke's aggregate win rate is still >50% for other reasons (e.g. Pyke's flex/roam value outside lane, or sample composition). There is no kit-level basis to instead flip specific stages to Pyke.
audit.corrected: Left the level chart and whys/why text as-is; recorded the contradiction in notes rather than guess a flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no number in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Dark Binding is a flat 10s cooldown root — the number that governs when Pyke can safely approach.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flagged that Morgana's sustain (Soul Siphon P, Tormented Shadow W) needs Grievous Wounds timing, and that Dark Binding/Black Shield/Soul Shackles all cancel Pyke's Q channel — neither was stated.
audit.why: Morgana heals off her passive and W damage over time, so extended trades without anti-heal favor her; and her Q root, E shield (which blocks disables), and R chains can all interrupt Pyke's channeled Q before it lands.
audit.corrected: Folded the channel-cancel point into dosFull/breakdown edits; anti-heal added as a new dontsFull note.

edits.before: Q-threat the cover, E the gap, X the threshold — the chain pays your whole team.
edits.after: Her Q, Black Shield, and Soul Shackles all cancel your Q channel — only start the skewer once her CC is already spent.

edits.before: Fishing visibly at half HP — Pyke's health bar is a rumor only fog can keep.
edits.after: Soul Siphon and Tormented Shadow both heal her through chip damage — buy anti-heal or your poke does nothing over an extended trade.

edits.before: Trade visible in his zone. Fish through his minion line. Stun-dive a banked root. The R settles fights — it doesn’t open negotiations.
edits.after: Trade visible in her zone. Fish through her minion line. Stun-dive a banked root. The R settles fights — it doesn’t open negotiations.

edits.before: - Morgana Dark Binding: matchup-defining — The three-second root — minion-block it; the pool follows wherever it lands. It writes your spacing rules. - W Ghostwater Dive is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Morgana Dark Binding: flat 10s cooldown, ~2.25s root — minion-block it; the pool follows wherever it lands. It writes your spacing rules. - Your W Camouflage is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

notes: packet.defects flags that the level chart (all 7 stages Morgana) contradicts the aggregate win rate (Pyke wins 53.17%). Content win[] already reads 'Morgana' for all 7 rows with kit-grounded whys (Black Shield negates Pyke's whole CC kit including R execute), so full-layer phases[N].side (previously the generic 'Skill' placeholder) was corrected to match — no win[N] edit needed. I could not find kit-level grounds to flip any specific stage to Pyke instead, so left the chart's per-stage content as-is and flag the aggregate-vs-chart contradiction for the user; it may reflect Pyke's value outside of lane (roam/flex) rather than a laning-stage error. diff/carryRating (TRICKY 7/10, threat 7.5/10) already reflect Morgana favoring the matchup and are left as-is.
